sources.officialityEvidence: Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade publishes this live, destination-specific entry guidance for Irish citizens and marks the page current.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irish citizens do not require a visa to enter Grenada.

policies.title: Irish ordinary passports: visa-free short visits to Grenada
policies.summary: Ireland's current destination-specific travel guidance expressly says Irish citizens do not require a visa to enter Grenada.
conditions: This records the ordinary Irish-passport visitor baseline only; passport validity, purpose, duration, carrier requirements and final admission remain applicable.
The source is current Irish government traveler guidance. It does not imply that travel is risk-free or guarantee entry.
